note: Features whose Playwright spec exists but cannot yet cover the whole §16.2 scenario. Each entry says what is pending and which task owns it. Never fake or skip a test to remove an entry: finish the scenario, then delete the entry. scripts/check-e2e-coverage.mjs counts these as PARTIAL; E9X_E2E_GATE=strict fails while any remains.

features.pending: 'chưa xác thực thì không mua được gói' through the checkout SCREEN: POST /api/orders already refuses an unverified learner (F39 asserts urn:e9x:problem:email-not-verified at the real endpoint, OrderServiceIT.unverifiedEmailCannotOrder), but there is no plan/checkout page yet, so the browser scenario (open a plan, try to pay, get refused, verify, the same order goes through) is pending.
features.owner: P5.4 (checkout screens)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.8): the work queue and the question editor are scoped to the exams of the person's grants ('AUTHOR IELTS không thấy/không sửa được câu TOEIC': the queue has nothing of TOEIC and the question cannot be opened or previewed), and a person who is both author and reviewer is not offered their own version to review in the queue. Pending: 'REVIEWER không duyệt được bản mình soạn' on the review SCREEN itself (the server refuses it, canReviewOwnVersion is false; the review screen that would show the refusal is P2.9's).
features.owner: P2.9 (review queue and decision screens)

features.pending: 'danh sách khoá/lớp đổi theo': there are no courses or classes yet. Today the data that changes with the context is the organisation's members and roles, the menus the roles open, and the switcher; the course and class lists must be asserted in the same two-organisation setup.
features.owner: P3.1 (courses), P6.1 (classes and members)

features.pending: 'mở URL lớp/khoá riêng của tổ chức B → 404': there is no class or course page or endpoint yet. Today the same scenario runs against the organisation-owned pages and endpoints that exist (members, roles, invitations) in the browser and over HTTP; the class and course URLs must be added.
features.owner: P3.1 (courses), P6.1 (classes)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.6): the author builds a TOEIC test on the screen part by part from published question groups, the screen checks it against the exam (a count that differs warns, a missing skill blocks the review), the number of resumes is set per test, the test is published only by a review that waits for its groups (a draft group refuses the approval), and an edit makes version 2 while version 1 stays PUBLISHED (the review is run by seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist). Pending: 'gắn bảng quy đổi ghi đè' on a screen (the TEST scope is enabled in the database since V202611120002 and resolve uses it, covered by TestVersionViewIT.publishingVersion2OfATestKeepsTheOverride and db-test 44; no CMS screen or endpoint writes the override yet: its header is the administrator's, its rows are versioned content), and the full-size tests 'TOEIC 200 câu' / 'IELTS 4 kỹ năng' with every count right (they need ~100 published questions: the Excel import of P2.7 makes them).
features.owner: P2.7 (import: full-size tests), the override screen (an administrator's)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.4): the author writes a lesson with all ten block types on the editor screen, the server keeps them in order, refuses a video host outside the allowlist and a lesson without a question type, and publishes the lesson only through a review that waits for the embedded question (the review is run by seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist). The learner side is covered by Vitest (StrategyLessonView: every block, the embedded question hides its answer until the learner has answered) and by StrategyLessonIT. Pending: 'học viên thấy đúng' in the browser: there is no learner lesson route until P3.2, which must render StrategyLessonView from QuestionVersions#examView, a signed link per file and an answer checker, and extend this spec with the learner reading a published lesson (frames from YouTube/Vimeo allowed by the CSP, the embedded question answered).
features.owner: P3.2 (lesson page), P2.9 (review queue replaces seed.reviewVersion)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.5): the author makes the DEFAULT table of an exam skill on the screen, the server refuses a gap in the raw values and a score that falls (TableConverter), the table is published only by a review (seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist), an edit makes version 2 and the published version is untouched, version 1 is archived when 2 is published. Pending: 'ghi đè' on the screen (since P2.6 the database accepts a TEST-scope table for a real test, written by the administrator of the test's owner only, and ScoreTables#resolve uses it for every version of the test; the score-table CMS still answers 409 for scope TEST and no screen sets an override: see the F13 entry), and 'kết quả thi dùng đúng bảng; sửa bảng không đổi kết quả cũ' (an exam result records the score table version it used: no results exist yet).
features.owner: the override screen (an administrator's, with the F13 entry), P4.1 (results use and record the table version)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.5): the author writes the IELTS Writing Task 2 skill on the screen (rubric, criteria, prompt template with the four variables, scored samples, result schema that must declare every criterion), a review publishes it, a teacher of the exam reads the published one and a learner never does, an edit makes version 2. Pending: 'chạy thử với bài mẫu' (the dry run calls the AI grader of P4.2 and validates the answer against the result schema: the server answers 501 dry-run-unavailable and sends nothing until then) and 'dùng khi chấm' (the AI grading job takes the published skill of the question type).
features.owner: P4.2 (AiGrader: the dry run), P4.3 (the grading job uses the skill)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.3): editing a published question makes a new draft version and never touches the published one, one open version per question, a colleague cannot take a draft over, the new version is published only by a review (run by seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist). Pending: 'học viên đang thi vẫn thấy bản cũ' (a learner IN an exam keeps reading the version the attempt began on: no exam room exists yet) and the side-by-side comparison of two versions (diff screen) and the approval by a person in the review queue.
features.owner: P3.4 (exam room: the attempt keeps its version), P2.9 (review queue and version comparison)

features.pending: Driven through the real API of the running stack (plans, order within the course limit, locked price, verified-email rule, order code and transfer note, expiry job with a SYSTEM audit record); the QR, the payment account and the administrator's confirmation are covered by F40 (P5.2). Pending: the browser steps that choose a plan and courses on the checkout page.
features.owner: P5.4 (plan and checkout screens)

features.pending: The gate (billing.api.Entitlements) and the PLAN_EXPIRING / PLAN_EXPIRED notices are asserted through the seed API and the learner's own API. Pending: 'cannot open a lesson / can still read old results' on the real screens, which call the gate: lesson page and exam room do not exist yet.
features.owner: P3.1 (lesson gate), P3.3 (exam: canContinueAttempt), P4.4 (results page)

features.pending: The acceptance line names three kinds of record: order confirmation, seat revocation and content approval. The spec covers what exists, through the real screens and the real services: organisation creation, role changes, invitation send/revoke/accept, order confirmation (P5.2: a real order placed and confirmed through the billing endpoints, one transaction with the audit record), seat revocation (P5.3: a real licence, a seat assigned and taken back by the organisation's ORG_ADMIN, the record filed under the seat with ids and no address) and content approval (a real ReviewService run over a stand-in e2e_doc version through seed.reviewFlow, since the CMS review screens do not exist yet), read on the real audit-log screen by the SYS_ADMIN and refused to everybody else. Pending: content approval through the real CMS review screen instead of the seed arrives with P2.9.
features.owner: P2.9 (review screen replaces seed.reviewFlow)

features.pending: The 8 main screens of the design mockups are not built yet: 01 course catalogue, 02 chapter map, 03 lesson, 04 exam room Reading, 05 exam room Speaking, 06 result, 07 CMS review queue, 08 admin QR orders. They move from PENDING_MAIN_SCREENS to SCREENS in the spec as they appear (see its header and the P1.12 note in the foundation plan).

Done through the real stack (P5.2): the SYS_ADMIN sets the receiving account on the screen, the order page shows the QR (a 512 px PNG), the account, the exact amount and note, the SYS_ADMIN confirms one order and rejects another on the queue screen, access opens from the confirmation, the learner is told in the app and by mail, the audit log holds the decisions without an account number or the reason's text, a second decision is 409. Pending: the browser steps that PLACE the order (plan/course pickers, checkout page) and decoding the QR on the page with jsQR. The scan with three real bank apps is a manual pre-release step of the owner.
features.owner: P5.4 (checkout screens, jsQR decode)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P2.8): the preview of every question type of the catalog is opened from the editor, shows the learner's side (stem, options, gaps, media) and never a word of the solution side (answer key, explanation, transcript, model answer). Pending: 'giống phòng thi': until the exam room of P3.4 exists the preview is the CMS's minimal renderer keyed by InteractionKind; P3.4 replaces it with the room's own question component and this spec must then also compare the preview with the room's rendering of the same question.
features.owner: P3.4 (exam room component replaces the minimal renderer)

features.pending: Done through the real stack (P3.1): the author builds a STRICT course on the screen (the server checks the six-character code; a taken code is 409), a review publishes it, and the REAL lesson gate answers ALLOWED / LOCKED / NOT_ENTITLED as the rule, the learner's progress (stated by the test through seed.course.gate) and the entitlement say, for STRICT, COMPLETION (score ignored) and FREE. Pending: the same through the learner's own screens, with progress written by real lesson completions and chapter tests (the lesson page and the learning module that owns progress are P3.2's).
features.owner: P3.2 (lesson page, chapter map, real progress)
